title: Money names / poster in a laundrette
slide_intent: Use familiar local words to make a broad financial promise feel culturally near to the viewer.
strategic_value: A dense stack of money names can let Wise combine international ambition with informal language.
demonstration: A person holds a bright-green poster in front of washing machines; oversized dark words include Peso, Plata, Chavos, Pasta, Dinero and Lana.
practical_value: Compare a vocabulary-led headline with a conventional product-benefit statement.
